constraints.name: production_scoring_admission_closure_kind_shape_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((closure_kind = 'LEGACY_ADMISSION'::text) AND (prior_legacy_closure_id IS NULL) AND (authority = 'GOOGLE'::text)) OR ((closure_kind = 'SUPABASE_INGRESS'::text) AND (prior_legacy_closure_id IS NOT NULL) AND (authority = 'SUPABASE'::text))))

constraints.name: production_scoring_admission_prior_legacy_closure_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (prior_legacy_closure_id) REFERENCES production_control.scoring_admission_closures(closure_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: production_scoring_closure_boundary_evidence_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((boundary_mode = 'PROVIDER_FENCE_V2'::text) AND (external_fence_evidence_id IS NOT NULL) AND (google_writer_provider_fence_id IS NOT NULL) AND (google_writer_provider_verification_id IS NOT NULL) AND (first_source_fingerprint IS NULL) AND (first_source_captured_at IS NULL) AND (second_source_captured_at IS NULL) AND (supabase_shadow_fingerprint IS NULL) AND (unexplained_difference_count IS NULL)) OR ((boundary_mode = 'MAINTENANCE_WINDOW_V1'::text) AND (external_fence_evidence_id IS NULL) AND (google_writer_provider_fence_id IS NULL) AND (google_writer_provider_verification_id IS NULL) AND ((status = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSING'::text, 'REOPENED'::text])) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['CLOSED'::text, 'CONSUMED'::text])) AND (first_source_fingerprint IS NOT NULL) AND (first_source_captured_at IS NOT NULL) AND (second_source_captured_at IS NOT NULL) AND (second_source_captured_at >= first_source_captured_at) AND (final_source_fingerprint = first_source_fingerprint) AND (final_source_fingerprint = supabase_shadow_fingerprint) AND (unexplained_difference_count = 0))))))

constraints.name: scoring_admission_closures_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'CLOSING'::text) AND (closed_at IS NULL) AND (reopened_at IS NULL) AND (consumed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'CLOSED'::text) AND (closed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (reopened_at IS NULL) AND (consumed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'REOPENED'::text) AND (reopened_at IS NOT NULL) AND (consumed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'CONSUMED'::text) AND (closed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (consumed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (consumed_epoch_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: scoring_admission_closures_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = 'CLOSING'::text) OR ((closed_admission_revision IS NOT NULL) AND (final_source_fingerprint IS NOT NULL) AND (reconciliation_fingerprint IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_set_fingerprint IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(supabase_match_revisions) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(google_checkpoints) = 'object'::text)) OR (status = 'REOPENED'::text)))

constraints.name: scoring_admission_closures_consumed_epoch_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (consumed_epoch_id) REFERENCES scoring_authority.authority_epochs(epoch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: scoring_admission_closures_external_fence_evidence_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (external_fence_evidence_id) REFERENCES production_control.scoring_external_fence_evidence(evidence_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: scoring_admission_closures_google_writer_provider_fence_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (google_writer_provider_fence_id) REFERENCES production_control.google_writer_provider_fences(fence_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: scoring_admission_closures_google_writer_provider_verifica_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (google_writer_provider_verification_id) REFERENCES production_control.google_writer_provider_fence_verifications(verification_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: scoring_admission_closures_tournament_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tournament_id) REFERENCES scoring_authority.tournaments(tournament_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
